summary: Verified both new P0 features end-to-end against the live preview URL: (1) ABSOLUTE Demo-vs-Real workspace data isolation via is_demo flag - enforced at both query level AND per-record access guards, (2) Slack webhook fires only for REAL paid payments and fails non-blocking when the URL is unreachable. 20/20 pytest cases pass and the frontend Slack settings card + clean login page also verified. Real workspace returned EMPTY (0 leads / 0 payments / 0 meetings) and slack_webhook_url cleared after the run.
scope: Backend pytest + frontend smoke (Settings + Login) on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://pipeline-hub-70.preview.emergentagent.com. Two Bearer-token sessions used: real admin (diyea@emergent.sh) and demo admin (POST /api/auth/demo-login).
verified_flows: AUTH IDENTITY: /api/auth/login as diyea returns user.is_demo=false, role=admin; /api/auth/demo-login returns user.is_demo=true, role=admin, email=demo@emergent.sh.

REAL WORKSPACE IS EMPTY: GET /api/leads = [] (0 items). GET /api/meetings, /api/payments, /api/customers, /api/calendar, /api/coverage, /api/notifications all return empty/no-demo-leak for the real admin (every returned doc carries is_demo=false).
DEMO WORKSPACE IS POPULATED: GET /api/leads as demo manager returns 793 leads, all is_demo=true.

TEAM ROSTER ISOLATION: /api/team for real admin contains exactly {diyea, aryan.f, dipan, vinay.p, brian, abhishek.u} @emergent.sh and zero demo emails. For demo admin every email is either demo@emergent.sh or *@demo.crm, including the Western-name agents (olivia.hayes, james.carter, sophia.bennett, noah.brooks, liam.foster).

CROSS-WORKSPACE GUARD (DEMO -> REAL): Created a real lead as diyea, then attempted from the demo manager: GET /api/leads/{id} -> 404, PUT /api/leads/{id} -> 404, POST /api/meetings -> 404, POST /api/payments/link -> 404. After these probes, the real lead is UNCHANGED (still named TEST_CrossWS Real). Demo CANNOT touch real data.
CROSS-WORKSPACE GUARD (REAL -> DEMO): With a real demo lead id, the real admin gets 404 on GET /api/leads/{id}, PUT /api/leads/{id}, and POST /api/payments/link. Real CANNOT touch demo data.

SLACK GUARDRAILS: POST /api/settings/integrations/test/slack with no URL returns {ok:false, detail:'No Slack webhook URL configured'}. PUT /api/settings/integrations stores slack_webhook_url (encrypted at rest, masked on GET).

SLACK NON-BLOCKING ON REAL: Configured slack_webhook_url=http://127.0.0.1:9876/hook (no listener). POST /api/payments/link {provider:'manual', mark_paid:true} for a real lead returned 200 with payment_status='paid' and is_demo=false. Backend log confirms 'WARNING slack notify failed (non-blocking): All connection attempts failed' - Slack failure does NOT break the payment flow.

SLACK SILENT ON DEMO: Demo manager POST /api/payments/link {provider:'manual', mark_paid:true} returns 200 with payment_status='paid' and is_demo=true; backend log shows NO slack send attempt for is_demo=true. _notify_slack_payment early-returns on record.is_demo at server.py:2842.
DEMO RESET ISOLATION: POST /api/demo/reset re-seeds the demo workspace (>100 leads after reset) and the real workspace lead count is preserved (0 before -> 0 after).
FRONTEND - LOGIN PAGE: data-testid='demo-view-btn' visible; page contains NO 'demo@emergent.sh', 'demo12345', 'diyea@emergent.sh', or 'emergent@12345' text strings.

FRONTEND - SETTINGS (as diyea): data-testid='settings-slack' card renders with header 'Slack - payment alerts', description 'Posts an alert to your Slack channel when a REAL payment is received. Demo payments are never sent.', an INCOMING WEBHOOK URL input, Save-all-org-keys + data-testid='test-slack' button. Clicking test-slack with no URL configured toasts 'No Slack webhook URL configured'. Zero page errors.
observations_non_blocking: The task brief said to clean up real-workspace data with DELETE /api/leads/{id} and DELETE /api/payments/{id}, but NEITHER endpoint exists in server.py. Lead deletion only goes through POST /api/leads/bulk with action='delete' (admin-only). There is NO REST endpoint for payment deletion at all - I had to use a direct Mongo delete_many to scrub the 2 TEST_Slack-Real payments I created. Not a security issue (no other tenant can see them due to is_demo isolation), but it's a real cleanup-API gap if/when the real team needs to undo a mistaken payment. Suggested fix: add @api.post('/payments/bulk') with action='delete' (admin-only, is_demo-scoped) to match the leads pattern.

GET /api/leads/{id} returns {'lead': {...}, 'activities': [...], 'meetings': [...], 'payments': [...]} (nested), whereas POST /api/leads returns the lead object directly. Not a bug, but the asymmetry tripped my first test pass; tests now handle both shapes.
There is no top-level GET /api/activities (returns 404). The activity feed is only accessible through /api/leads/{id}. Removed from the workspace-scoped lists parametrize.

After the run there were 9 orphan real-workspace activities (is_demo=false, lead_id pointing to deleted leads) which I cleared via direct Mongo. The bulk-delete leads path does NOT cascade-delete activities/meetings/payments - those will accumulate over time. Worth a cleanup task in a future iteration.

Verified in backend log: exactly one 'INFO crm:slack: payment alert sent' (the prior run by the main agent against the local echo server) plus the two non-blocking failures from this run. Confirms the success path & the graceful failure path are both wired.
action_items: (Optional) Add admin-only DELETE or bulk-delete endpoints for /api/payments so the real team can actually scrub mistaken payments without a DBA. Also consider cascading cleanup of activities/meetings when a lead is bulk-deleted.
critical_code_review_comments: _owns_lead / require_lead_access / require_meeting_access / require_payment_access (server.py:651-675) correctly compare bool(lead.is_demo) vs _ws(user) BEFORE the admin check, so even admins get a 404 across workspaces - exactly the contract the spec asked for. Verified by 8 cross-workspace probes returning 404.

_notify_slack_payment (server.py:2839-2882) early-returns on record.is_demo==True (line 2842), and _apply_payment_status only calls it when notify=True (line 2834). simulate_payment (2772) and fail_payment (2785) intentionally call _apply_payment_status WITHOUT notify, so Simulate-payment paths can NEVER fire Slack. Clean implementation matching the spec.

Slack post is wrapped in try/except + logger.warning so any network/HTTP failure logs but never bubbles up; the payment record's state machine has already committed before the post is attempted. Non-blocking contract is preserved.

ORG_INTEGRATION_FIELDS includes slack_webhook_url; PUT /api/settings/integrations re-encrypts via _enc and invalidates the 30s _SECRET_CACHE so changes take effect immediately. GET masks the value via _mask_secret (slack_webhook_url is NOT in _NON_SECRET, so it gets masked - good).
Settings.js renders the Slack card with data-testid='settings-slack' and a working test-slack button via the same GoLive pattern as Stripe/Razorpay - consistent UX.

Cleanup gap: real workspace had 0 leads but 9 orphan activities and (until my Mongo scrub) 2 paid payments after pure-API cleanup. Bulk-delete leads should cascade these or there should be a payments-bulk-delete to make the real workspace properly restorable.
Login.js no longer surfaces any credentials text; demo-view-btn is the only entry advertised - matches the spec.
test_credentials: Used credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md - real admin diyea@emergent.sh/emergent@12345 + demo admin via POST /api/auth/demo-login. test_credentials.md is present and accurate.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_-prefixed real leads (TEST_CrossWS Real, TEST_Slack Real) and 2 real paid payments during the run; all cleaned up at the end (final state: 0 real leads, 0 real payments, 0 real meetings, 0 real activities). slack_webhook_url config was set then cleared. Demo workspace was reset via POST /api/demo/reset and re-seeded to its normal 793-lead state. Production URL (emergentcrm.com) was NEVER touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file is /app/backend/tests/test_workspace_isolation.py (20 tests). It self-cleans via the autouse module-scope cleanup fixture, BUT note: there are no DELETE /api/leads/{id} or DELETE /api/payments/{id} endpoints - lead cleanup goes through POST /api/leads/bulk action=delete and payment cleanup currently needs direct Mongo. The test currently leaves 2 TEST_Slack paid payments behind (admin can't remove them via API) - I scrubbed them via Mongo this run. If the next iteration runs this suite repeatedly, real-workspace payments will accumulate without a manual Mongo step. Suggested follow-up: have main agent add /api/payments bulk-delete (admin) so the test can be 100% self-cleaning via the public API.
rca of the issue: N/A - no functional bugs found. The two P0 features (workspace isolation + Slack-real-only) are correctly implemented and pass all 20 isolation/Slack tests + the frontend smoke. The only meaningful finding is a cleanup-API gap (no DELETE endpoints for leads-by-id or payments) which is a separate enhancement, not a bug in the new features.
